facts.fact: 湖难后 Alexander 回家，衣服肮脏、头发结成块
facts.anchor: His clothes, however, were filthy, his hair matted and dried in clumps.

facts.fact: 她对视一眼即知什么都没变，他的心是空屋、已搬往别处
facts.anchor: But in that one glance I saw that nothing had changed. That his heart was an empty house; he had moved elsewhere.

facts.fact: 没人知道 Alexander 和 Nick 为何没冻死，只有猜测
facts.anchor: How neither Alexander nor Nick succumbed to hypothermia nobody knows

facts.fact: Eliza 用浓重苏格兰口音说「别在意那些」
她为婚姻棺材上的钉子哭泣，也哭失去母亲和 Tom
facts.anchor: I cried for the nail in the coffin of my marriage

facts.fact: Nick 开口告诉她已找到她的父亲
Nick 说出她母亲给她的姓氏 Meneses
Nick 说她真实父亲叫 Edward、来自约克郡
facts.anchor: His name was Edward. He was from Yorkshire.
